Bug_Explanation: The error occurs when a new String object is created with 'new String("bar")'. This is not necessary as strings are immutable and can be safely shared.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when a new String object is created in the StringInstantiationBug class. In the test case, assertNotSame is used to compare the expected string 'bar' with the actual string returned by the showBug() method. Since a new String object is created in the StringInstantiationBug class, the expected and actual strings are not the same object, causing the test to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the expected and actual strings are not the same object, but the content is the same. This does not confirm the presence of the StringInstantiation bug, as the bug is about instantiating a new String object when it's not necessary. In this case, the String object is not being instantiated unnecessarily.
